deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: Canary rollout v12 (model=redwood-v12-stream) — streaming tail p99=4.20s (baseline 0.90s), p95=1.12s, streaming stalls ~1.5%. Small error-rate uptick. Paging @Ben (Oncall). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/canary/rollouts/5143216789
Ben (Oncall): ACK. joining. what's current traffic % to canary?
deploy-bot: current_canary_traffic=15% across 10 pods; rollout started 02:00Z (2m ago)
Maria SRE: joining. grabbing logs + traces. early guess: multiplex queueing + KV cache thrash on the canary path.
Maria SRE: metrics snapshot:
```
canary_id: v12
p95: 1.12s
p99: 4.20s
streaming_stalls: 1.5%
kv_evictions/sec: baseline=40 -> now=130
mux_queue_depth: baseline=2 -> now=18
```
Maria SRE: logs show repeated timeouts when flushing streaming chunks:
```
[streaming_worker] WARN send_chunk timeout after 2500ms - conn_id=1234 pod=canary-7
[encoder] INFO async_kv_warmup miss key=embedding_cache shard=5
```
Ben (Oncall): OK. Two immediate mitigations: 1) shift canary traffic to 0% (rollback traffic) 2) enable fallback streaming model (v11-stream-slim) for the streaming route. I'll coordinate rollback now.
Ana (DevEx): I'm pulling customer telemetry. initial list: cust-acme, cust-zeta, cust-pulse showing >2s tail. I'll post an incident note in #support and ping CSMs.
Ben (Oncall): running command to shift traffic:
```
redwoodctl rollout traffic shift --deployment canary-v12 --to 0 --reason "p99 streaming spike"
```
deploy-bot: action accepted. traffic shift queued (controller=rollout-274), rolling traffic to 0%
Leo (Runtime): I can also apply an ingress rate limit on the canary pods to reduce multiplex queueing. Applying soft limiter 50r/s now.
Leo (Runtime): applied limiter to pods canary-0..9
Maria SRE: seeing initial effect — p99 down to 1.5s within 3m, p95 ~0.95s, streaming stalls to 0.3%
Ben (Oncall): nice. keep rollback & rate limiter until we confirm stability. Maria, can you collect a small set of failing traces (trace ids) for postmortem?
Maria SRE: collected trace ids: trace-0x1a, trace-0x1b, trace-0x1c. attaching to thread (links).
Ana (DevEx): support ping sent: "We're rolling traffic back due to increased latency during a canary. Short-term rollback in progress; we'll update when stable." :wave: 
Ben (Oncall): Incident status — Mitigation in progress. I'll remain on the incident and handoff to @Leo at 03:00Z local. If p99 < 1s for 30m and no streaming stalls we'll close.
Maria SRE: agree. initial root cause hypothesis: v12 introduced a quantization kernel that increases KV warmup costs under multiplexed streaming. Recommend blocking v12 from further canaries until we reproduce and patch.
Ana (DevEx): creating customer impact note and notifying Product. drafting postmortem stub.
deploy-bot: rollback completed by Ben at 02:08Z, canary traffic=0%
Maria SRE: steady state after rollback+limiter: p95=0.88s p99=0.96s streaming_stalls=0.02%
Ben (Oncall): holding oncall. handoff to Leo at 03:00Z confirmed. tagging Eng Runtime & ML applied research for root cause: @Leo @Maria SRE @Ana (DevEx)
Maria SRE: marking this P1 -> postmortem required. please preserve all artifacts: traces, canary logs, rollout configs, quantization flags from v12 (git sha: abcdef12)
Ana (DevEx): will coordinate customer comms, timeline, and action items for a follow-up incident review. :white_check_mark:
Ben (Oncall): closing active pager, will monitor for 30m then close thread. thanks all.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Pager resolved at 5143216845
